changeSet.author: ttn
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE audit_log ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), actor_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('USER','AGENT','SYSTEM')), actor_id VARCHAR(64), company_id VARCHAR(64), action VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, target_type VARCHAR(40), target_id VARCHAR(100), detail JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', trace_id VARCHAR(64), ip_address VARCHAR(45) ); CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_target ON audit_log (target_type, target_id); CREATE INDEX idx_audit_log_time ON audit_log (company_id, occurred_at DESC); CREATE TABLE feedback ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), target_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('EXPLANATION','ANSWER','PROPOSAL','ENTRY_SUGGESTION')), target_id UUID NOT NULL, user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user(id), rating SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (rating IN (-1, 1)), comment TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uk_feedback_target_user UNIQUE (target_type, target_id, user_id) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE feedback; DROP TABLE audit_log;
